Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Join target_dictionary, assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1075092, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return rows ordered by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
